excerpt.zh: 随着虚境信标的下线，我们失去了进入虚境甬道网络的通行权。除非信标得以替换，否则我们的舰队不能利用网络。
excerpt.en: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.
